prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you want quick local recommendations now, or a tailored search based on your car, budget, and whether you need same‑day service?

A few quick, reliable options (pros/cons) that most Pleasanton drivers use:
- Costco Tire Center — usually very competitive prices and a good warranty/road‑hazard option; must be a Costco member. Good for standard passenger tires and reliable install service.
- Discount Tire / America’s Tire — strong reputation for fast turnaround, good prices, free flat repairs in some locations, and experienced installers.
- Firestone Complete Auto Care (and Pep Boys / NTB) — full service shops that do mounting, balancing and alignments; convenient if you want an alignment or other work done at the same time.
- Local independent tire shops — often provide very personalized service and attention to detail for mounting, torque, and alignments. Quality varies, so choose by reviews and certifications.

How to pick the best installer (check these before you book)
- Read local Google and Yelp reviews (look for many recent 4–5 star reviews).
- Ask if they include mounting, balancing, new valve stems, and torqueing lug nuts in the quote.
- Ask whether TPMS programming is included (if you have TPMS sensors) and what they charge for it.
- Confirm whether an alignment is included or if they recommend/offer one after install (alignment is important for new tires).
- Ask about warranty/road‑hazard coverage and tire disposal fee.
- Check technician credentials (ASE certification is a good sign) and whether they use computerized balancers.
- Ask about wait time and whether they do a test drive/check after installation.

If you want, I can:
- Suggest 3–5 highly rated shops in Pleasanton (I’ll need your ZIP or whether you prefer national chains vs. independents), or
- Walk you through what questions to ask when you call for a price/appointment.

Which would you prefer, and what vehicle/tire size or brand are you looking for?
